steps.content:
I'd call it a tie. The two listings match on everything I could see.

| | Brackmoor Sound (A) | Ottervale Audio (B) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Box contents | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

The product specs are also identical. Both listings show the same rating and review count. That may mean the reviews are for the product as a whole and not for each seller. If so, the rating tells you nothing about either seller.

**What I'd do:**
- Before you pay, check each seller's own reputation, such as seller ratings, reviews on third-party sites, and how long they've been in business. The listings don't show any of that, and it's the only thing that would separate them.
- If you still can't decide, buy from whichever seller you've used before or find more trustworthy. You could also check whether one offers a better checkout deal, like a coupon, a payment option, or a different return process. Neither listing mentions any of these.

I only had the two listing pages to go on. I couldn't see the sellers' own pages or any reviews of them, so I can't say that one is safer.
